blurb: Go Fish Santa Cruz Charters offers fishing trips targeting Salmon, Rock Cod, Lingcod, Halibut, and Tuna depending on the season. They also provide combo trips combining crab and fish species, crab-only trips, whale watching, cruises, and ash scattering at sea. Their 30' Island Hopper boat is equipped for fishing and scenic cruises along the Central Coast of California from San Francisco to Big Sur.
